title: Large-c BCFT Entanglement Entropy with Deformed Boundaries from Emergent JT Gravity
summary: We study the effect of boundary deformations on the von Neumann entropy of subregions in two-dimensional boundary conformal field theories (BCFTs) at zero and finite temperature. The deformations considered are infinitesimal global conformal transformations that move the boundary and can equivalently be viewed as the leading-order effect of certain BCFT perturbations with the boundary displacement operator. We demonstrate that at large central charge the von Neumann entropy in the presence of a deformed boundary is reproduced by the island entropy of the same interval in an undeformed BCFT…
